LIVE CREW CONTROLS

W A S D move · Shift sprint · Mouse aim (click game to lock camera) · Left mouse fire on Planet B · E interact · Enter chat · Esc release cursor.

BUILD: Approach glowing ship terminals and press E repeatedly to align and fasten their modules (3 fasteners each). Any specialist can help, with a contribution bonus for their own terminal. FLIGHT: Service ship systems. PLANET B: Approach glowing science crystals, press E to pick up, return to your team's ship and press E to load (max 4). RETURN: Hold on to the loaded cargo. DELIVERY: Approach the receiving beacon beside your ship and press E once per sample. Enemy attacks can knock you out and drop your carried sample.

Host must start with at least 2 connected players from different teams. This online arena is an additional playable multiplayer mode; the original detailed single-player campaign and offline engineering simulation are unchanged.
